text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are holding their recent highs with essentially flat 24-hour movement, suggesting consolidation rather than weakness at current price levels. The Fear & Greed index at 71 indicates sustained greed sentiment, though the zero 7-day change hints that this elevated mood may have plateaued rather than accelerating. Bitcoin dominance at 58.3% paired with $109B daily volume shows healthy participation across the broader market, with altcoins like SOL and BNB edging upward while the majors rest.
